title: brief.json
description: What stage 7 writes and build/web.py renders (73-web-plan.md § The contract). This file is the single source of truth for the shape. tools/brief-check.py enforces it with a validator that knows exactly the keywords used here, plus x-maxWords: a cap on whitespace-separated words, counted on a string, or on a span array's t values joined. CAPS: every x-maxWords and maxItems bound below is measured on live T (sha256 b15781da...4abae2) through its mechanical export tools/fixtures/web/northwind-t.json, and equals T's maximum, because live T is the gold standard (43-rulings.md:112-123). One exception: live T cut its matrix legend, so T measures 0 there, and the legend's x-maxWords 45 is the last legend before the cut. A minItems bound is a floor, not a measurement. T passes at its own edge and nothing longer does. Names are never capped: a name is printed verbatim from its owner's site, and a cap would force a cut name. Spans concatenate verbatim, so a span's t keeps its own leading space.

jd_url.description: The job ad the run started from, as run.json holds it.

role.description: The role title, verbatim from the job ad (PL).

dates.description: D4. evidence: the first and last fetch day of the claim-backing pages. page: the day the final build stamped, in Europe/London.

run_date.description: The one day the run's counted pages were fetched (T:build-t.py:56-60).

rivals.description: In the order the run line and the matrix list them; the map follows map.answers. maxItems 6: T's rivals.

quick_take.description: One item per paragraph: a bold lede, then the body. maxItems 3: T's paragraphs.

moves.description: One table row per rival with a move or a silence worth naming. maxItems 5: T's rows.

moves_heading.description: The authored h2 over moves, under matrix.heading's checks (the operator, 2026-10-09). x-maxWords 5: as matrix.heading.

open_questions.description: One list item each. maxItems 2 and x-maxWords 32: T's two questions, 32 and 19 words.

ref.description: The claims.jsonl row(s) a text rests on: one ID, or two or more when the text's card cites more than one source (T's chips carry up to two). null only on connective text holding no numeral, name or quote.

span_id.description: A span's stable key: <section>.<item>.<field>.<n> (qt, rec, move, oq, legend), assigned once by tools/backfill-globex.py assign_span_ids and kept through every edit; a span added later takes a fresh key. Findings, patches and verify.jsonl name spans by it.

cmp.description: On a span citing only the hiring company's own rows: the id of the span in the same sentence whose rows are a rival's, so the pair reads as a comparison (KR-H, D14).

q.description: Printed in curly quotes; t is verbatim in the quote of an en row c names.

g.description: An English gloss of a non-en row c names, verbatim from its gloss; printed after T's lead (T:build-t.py:676).

name.description: Verbatim from the company's snapshot, as on its own site.

domain.description: The company's registrable domain, its snapshot's domain. Set on the hiring company: KR-H keys known rows on it.

short.description: The shorter form the page prints beside rivals (run line, map, matrix header); absent means name. T prints Northwind in its h1 and Northwind elsewhere.

logo.description: The slug of a gated record in $BRIEF_ROOT/logos/logos.json; null sets the name as a wordmark.

slot.description: The paragraph's job in the quick take: the thesis, a proof paragraph, or the ICP paragraph the allocation's ICP rows back (X2).

test.description: The bold claim. x-maxWords 28: T's third.

next_step.description: Printed after the template's label. x-maxWords 13: T's first.

date.description: The latest dated event the change cell reports; null for a silence.

meaning.description: What it means and the action, less the tag. x-maxWords 18: T's ev.energy row.

action.description: The tag the template prints: Act or Watch.

question.description: Lower case, no question mark: the template joins both into the map's caption. x-maxWords 9: T's across.

yes.description: The yes category's header. x-maxWords 6: T's down.

no.description: The no category's header. x-maxWords 6: T's down.

serves.description: The locked question the axis serves: its Q<n> in 02-questions.md.

metric.description: The counted thing the axis asks about, matched against the counted-thing half of each cited row's metric (M5).

answer.description: yes or no. The vocabulary is brief-check rule M1, not an enum here, so one defect has one finding.

name.description: On a yes, the counterparty the card prints after the yes header; null on a no.

integration.description: Under a no answer only, the IDs from c whose evidence names the counterparty as an integration, not a customer; the card prints build/web.py's INTEG lead before each. Copied from 06-shape.json, where stage 6 names them (W2-rulings.md G10); [] where none is. brief-check M3 holds it within c and M4 holds it empty under a yes.

answers.description: One per company, the hiring company included. maxItems 7: T's companies.

t.description: x-maxWords 5: T's longest cell, 'Says yes, no GB unit'. This cap is the matrix-cell rule as a field cap. It absorbs P20-verify-2.md Cause A (:51-62): a qualifier rule stage 9 step 3 stated and no lint checked, broken by cells of that length that wrapped the PDF matrix past its budget.

mark.description: cited: c names the row(s) the cell rests on. unknown: c is null and the cell is a finding, rendered apart from a cited No (provenance rules 2 and 3).

heading.description: The one authored h2. x-maxWords 5: T's.

columns.description: Company slugs, in print order. maxItems 7: T's companies; the template adds the label column, so T prints 8 table columns.

label.description: x-maxWords 2: every T label is 2 words.

legend.description: The caveats Coverage Notes held. Live T cut its legend (RS-7), so T measures 0; x-maxWords 45 is the last legend before the cut, T:build-t.py:127.
